So the company is a trader/distributor of consumer electronics (phones, laptops) importing from UAE/USA and re-exporting to Russia. Declared HS set (847130;850811;850980;851010) is only partly matched by observed records: 84713010 confirmed on the 2026-01-27 MacBook line; 85171300 (smartphones) appears repeatedly but is NOT in the declared list; 850811/850980/851010 were not observed in any visible row. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground - HS should be corrected to the observed codes (84713010, 85171300) with the caveat that the full 875-record set was not readable on the free view. Export status is 'confirmed' on the strength of named Russian consignees with PO dates, but the export B/L numbers and export HS codes are null in the free view, so the export leg is confirmed as to existence and direction, not as to per-shipment HS. Domestic supply: no traces found in accessible sources - not asserted either way, marked unknown rather than declared_only. Role: trader (import-re-export distributor), not manufacturer. Search tooling (DuckDuckGo/searx) was down during this check and volza/eximpedia/trademo returned HTTP 403, so second-source cross-checking was limited to ImportKey.
